pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 4...Nfd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ng3 with no knight able to reach g3 in one step and an f4-f5 push. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling in plans 2-3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 4.e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview and plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 5.f4 c5 6.c3 Nc6 7.Ndf3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Ndf3-g3 and Ndf3-e1-g2 knight routes that do not exist; plan 1 vague. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 5.f4 c5 6.c3 Nc6 7.Ndf3 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...b6 and ...Ba6 with the queen on b6 and an f6-knight that is on d7; plan 3 claimed a3 stops ...b5; plan 1 had g3 and Bg2 defending d4. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 5.f4 c5 6.c3 Nc6 7.Ndf3 Qb6 8.g3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Kg2 and a Bg2 fianchetto; overview said the bishop goes to g2 (it heads for h3 in this line); plan 3 had an Nf3-e1-g2 reroute. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 5.f4 c5 6.c3 Nc6 7.Ndf3 Qb6 8.h4
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Ng3 and Kh1 with no piece able to play them. Rewrote plan 3 (Rh3, Ne2); British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 7.Ndf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f2-f4-f5 with a knight on f3; overview called ...c5 a break still to come and plan 3 a semi-open c-file that would be open. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 7.Ne2 a5
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the d7-knight to f8 where the bishop stands; overview had ...b5 as the point of ...a5. Rewrote overview and plan 4 (...a4 keeps the knight off b3); British spelling in plans 1-3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...f6 9.exf6, 11...O-O 12.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview called the d6-bishop light-squared and plan 1 had Bxf6 with no bishop able to take; plan 2 discussed a recapture on f6 already made; plan 4 rerouted a d7-knight that is not there. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4 (first overview rewrite rejected for a knight on f4 eyeing e5, reworded and re-accepted); British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...f6 9.exf6, 11...Qb6
pages.notes: Overview said White uses an e5-pawn that is not there; plan 3 named e4 and f5 as moves; plan 2 put a rook on e8 before castling; plan 1 had Nc3 bolstering d4. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling in plan 4.
